items.caption: The presence of an intimomedial flap is the diagnostic hallmark differentiating aortic dissection from other acute aortic syndromes.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Familial Paraganglioma Syndrome Type 1 (PGL1)
items.caption: SDHD mutations demonstrate a paternal parent-of-origin effect, meaning tumors typically develop only when the mutation is inherited from the father.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Chest
items.caption: Middle lobe and lingular bronchiectasis with nodules in an older woman suggests the nodular-bronchiectatic NTM pattern; imaging suggests it, microbiology confirms it.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Hip
items.caption: Keep avascular necrosis as a differential, not a synonym: it needs a focal subchondral lesion, a double-line sign or collapse.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Liver
items.caption: Multiple liver lesions alone cannot separate primary from metastatic neuroendocrine disease; with a known small-bowel primary, they are metastases.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Vascular
items.caption: Tumour thrombus needs internal enhancement, IVC expansion or continuity with a primary mass such as renal cell or hepatocellular carcinoma; a defect alone is indeterminate.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Neurocysticercosis
items.caption: Calcified neurocysticercosis is the end stage; a scolex belongs to the earlier vesicular stage, so do not assume one unless it is shown.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Bone scintigraphy
items.caption: Absent kidneys alone do not separate metabolic from metastatic superscan; symmetry and appendicular plus calvarial uptake favour metabolic.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Knee
items.caption: Humphrey runs in front of the PCL, Wrisberg behind it; do not mistake the ligament of Humphrey for a double PCL sign.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Chest
items.caption: A unilateral hyperlucent hemithorax can come from the chest wall: check the pectoral muscles before blaming the lung.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Ductal carcinoma in situ
items.caption: Fine linear branching calcifications are highly suggestive of high-grade DCIS and warrant immediate tissue sampling.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Osmotic demyelination syndrome
items.caption: The trident sign on DWI is a pathognomonic finding for central pontine myelinolysis in osmotic demyelination syndrome.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Dural arteriovenous fistula
items.caption: New-onset dural arteriovenous fistulas should be suspected in patients with persistent ocular symptoms or worsening venous congestion following the successful endovascular treatment of a direct carotid-cavernous fistula.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Mesenteric lymphangioma
items.caption: A well-defined, thin-walled, non-enhancing mesenteric cyst in an adult is most frequently a lymphangioma, which often requires surgical excision due to potential for mass effect or complications.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Diffusion-weighted imaging
items.caption: In the peripheral zone, think DWI first; in the transition zone, think T2WI first.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Hilgenreiner line and Shenton line
items.caption: The Shenton line is the most sensitive early radiographic indicator of hip joint subluxation or dislocation in children.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Cerebriform pattern
items.caption: The cerebriform pattern on MRI is a key diagnostic clue for inverted papilloma, reflecting its complex, infolded growth of squamous epithelium.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Serum anti-GM-CSF autoantibody testing
items.caption: The crazy-paving pattern on HRCT combined with high-titer serum anti-GM-CSF antibodies is diagnostic of autoimmune PAP, often obviating the need for surgical biopsy.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Oreo cookie sign
items.caption: The Oreo cookie sign on a lateral chest X-ray is a classic, highly specific indicator of pericardial effusion.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: High-resolution T2-weighted turbo spin-echo sequence
items.caption: The distance between the tumor margin and the mesorectal fascia is the most critical prognostic factor for CRM positivity.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Coffee bean sign
items.caption: The coffee bean sign on plain film is highly specific for sigmoid volvulus but lacks sensitivity in pediatric patients.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Leiomyosarcoma of the inferior vena cava
items.caption: A retroperitoneal mass with an imperceptible IVC wall and preserved lumen proximally and distally strongly suggests a primary venous leiomyosarcoma.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Cerebellar haemangioblastoma
items.caption: In a patient with a hypervascular spinal lesion and VHL syndrome, a cerebellar mass with high perfusion and no restricted diffusion is highly characteristic of a haemangioblastoma.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Retention of barium in the colon is a reliable marker for the proximal extent of the aganglionic segment.
items.caption: In suspected Hirschsprung disease, a 24-hour delayed abdominal radiograph showing retained barium is a strong predictor of the proximal extent of the aganglionic segment.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome polyposis
items.caption: Small bowel intussusception in a pediatric patient with mucocutaneous pigmentation should strongly raise suspicion for Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Stent placement across the compression
items.caption: Always consider endovascular stenting following mechanical thrombectomy for symptomatic iliac vein compression to prevent chronic venous hypertension.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Rigler's triad
items.caption: Rigler's triad is the pathognomonic radiological combination of pneumobilia, ectopic gallstone, and mechanical small bowel obstruction.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Origin of the bone fragment from the intercondylar eminence
items.caption: A Segond fracture is a cortical avulsion of the lateral tibial rim, whereas an ACL eminence avulsion involves the central intercondylar region.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Synovial osteochondromatosis
items.caption: The presence of multiple intra-articular loose bodies with characteristic signal intensity and secondary degenerative joint disease strongly suggests synovial osteochondromatosis.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Direct transfer to a regional neurosurgical department
items.caption: Early recognition and direct triage to a neurosurgical center are the most critical factors in improving outcomes for patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Skull base
items.caption: Cholesterol granuloma is the most common primary petrous apex lesion and is uniquely T1 and T2 bright.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Chemical shift artefact
items.caption: The presence of a bright-dark rim at the interface of intraventricular material on T1WI is highly suggestive of silicone oil due to its distinct chemical shift from CSF.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Popcorn sign
items.caption: Always consider the possibility of a collision tumor when a dural-based mass exhibits atypical imaging features like a peripheral hemosiderin ring.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Endobronchial carcinoid tumour
items.caption: The occurrence of a neuroendocrine tumor in a hypoplastic lung lobe is strongly associated with typical carcinoid histology.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Metabolic superscan
items.caption: Distinguish metabolic from metastatic superscans by the presence of appendicular skeletal involvement and the uniformity of tracer uptake.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Utilization of spectral detector CT virtual monoenergetic images
items.caption: Spectral CT virtual monoenergetic reconstruction at higher keV levels significantly reduces beam hardening artifacts compared to conventional polychromatic CT.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.caption: Contrast-enhanced 3D FLAIR is the most sensitive sequence for detecting leptomeningeal enhancement because it nulls the signal from CSF, effectively highlighting gadolinium extravasation.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Renal tuberculosis
items.caption: The classic triad of sterile pyuria, infundibular stenosis, and papillary cavitation should strongly raise suspicion for renal tuberculosis.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Gallbladder MiNEN
items.caption: A diagnosis of MiNEN requires the demonstration of both neuroendocrine and non-neuroendocrine components, each representing at least 30 percent of the tumor mass.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Emergent surgical exploration and repair
items.caption: Early surgical repair is critical for survival in Boerhaave syndrome as delay significantly increases mortality due to mediastinal sepsis.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: It demonstrates that the MRI signal void is partially due to intracranial calcification
items.caption: Brain calcification and iron deposition both cause blooming on T2* sequences, requiring non-contrast CT for definitive differentiation.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Brain tumours
items.caption: Choroid plexus xanthogranulomas are benign incidental masses that restrict diffusion and should not be confused with neoplasms requiring workup.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Diffusion restriction within the central cavity
items.caption: Always check the DWI signal of a ring-enhancing lesion because restricted diffusion in the cavity is the hallmark of a pyogenic abscess.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Moyamoya disease
items.caption: In young Asian adults with movement disorders and unexplained cerebral stenosis, consider the co-occurrence of Moyamoya disease and autoimmune thyroid conditions.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Intralobar pulmonary sequestration
items.caption: Intralobar sequestration is typically supplied by the thoracic aorta and drains into the pulmonary veins, whereas extralobar sequestration often drains into the systemic venous system.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Surgical exploration with resection of the involved bowel segment containing the duplication cyst
items.caption: Identify a pathological lead point in intussusception on ultrasound to avoid unnecessary attempts at hydrostatic or pneumatic reduction.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Salt and pepper appearance
items.caption: Look for the lyre sign on angiography and the salt and pepper appearance on MRI to confirm a carotid body tumor.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Fenestral otosclerosis
items.caption: Delayed 3D-FLAIR imaging after gadolinium administration can visualize blood-labyrinthine barrier compromise in active otosclerosis.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Mylohyoid muscle
items.caption: The key imaging finding for a plunging ranula is the extension of a fluid-filled mass from the sublingual space through the mylohyoid muscle into the submandibular space.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Brain arteriovenous malformation
items.caption: ASL has superior sensitivity to T2 and TOF sequences for detecting residual shunting in an AVM following radiosurgery.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Dual-phase 99mTc-Sestamibi scintigraphy
items.caption: Parathyroid adenomas are characterized by persistent tracer retention on delayed 99mTc-Sestamibi images due to high mitochondrial density and P-glycoprotein expression.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Malignant gastrointestinal stromal tumour
items.caption: GIST should be high on the differential for any large, heterogeneous, exophytic GI mass, especially when associated with peritoneal deposits or liver metastases in the absence of regional lymphadenopathy.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Contrast-enhanced CT angiography of the thorax
items.caption: Contrast-enhanced CTA is the primary diagnostic imaging tool for suspected tumoral vascular invasion or rupture in Pancoast tumors.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Detachable microcoils placed in the feeding arteries
items.caption: Always embolize the feeding artery proximal to the nidus using detachable coils to minimize the risk of paradoxical systemic embolization.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Wernicke encephalopathy
items.caption: Symmetric T2 hyperintensity in the mammillary bodies and medial thalami is highly specific for Wernicke encephalopathy.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Type 1 autoimmune pancreatitis
items.caption: Consider IgG4-related disease when a pancreatic mass lacks significant ductal dilation and is associated with renal involvement or migratory lesions.

items.subject: ss-radiology
items.title: Paget disease of bone
items.caption: The hallmark of Paget disease on imaging is the triad of cortical thickening, coarsened trabeculae, and bone enlargement.

items.subject: ophthalmology
items.title: Adult inclusion conjunctivitis
items.caption: Adult inclusion conjunctivitisis a type of follicular conjunctivitis caused by serotypes D to K of chlamydia trachomatis in sexually active young adults.

items.caption: Sole creases are a reliable physical marker for assessing gestational maturity.

items.caption: The posterior belly of the digastric is a key landmark for identifying the facial nerve as it exits the stylomastoid foramen.
